notes: 0.18.9 - PR #24 + #25 test build (stacked on PRs #17-#23, none merged). PR #24: the pie's dark backdrop is gone - the wheel floats on your wallpaper or the app beneath, the Opal hub always shows the clock, and the selected action or slider value moves to a small pill above the wheel. The settings editors are tidier too: Slices sits above Ring layouts, the handle editor collapses, and picker results scroll in a bounded list. PR #25: app rings. Add Favorite apps or Recent apps as a slice (picker > Rings, or the new Edge apps layout) - slide outward across the ring and it expands into its apps; release on one to open it, slide back toward the orb to return. Favorites follow your launcher pins; Recents uses Android usage history with Kinto's own launch record as fallback.
